lines.say: Stop saying, see you next time. Next time isn't a date.
Almost half of clients get one cut and never return. Nobody asked for the next one.
So ask right there in the chair. Saturday or Sunday? Don't say, do you want to rebook?
Then send the text before he leaves. You're locked in, Saturday at ten.
A date on the calendar gets kept. A maybe usually doesn't.
Comment the word keep and we'll show you who's gone quiet. Message Health dot net.
